resources.string: The kernel primitive was already entered in this boot. For safety, this app will not retry until the tablet has rebooted. Reboot, start Shizuku again, then reopen this app.
Module stages were not requested in this boot. Reboot, start Shizuku, then run Root My OnePlus Pad 3 again; modules must be started in the same initial late-load.

KernelSU loaded, but this boot has no verified module-stage completion marker. Start Shizuku and tap Refresh. If it remains unverified, reboot and run Root My OnePlus Pad 3 again with the modules already installed.
Root is disabled unless model, device, product, fingerprint, build, SDK, security patch, kernel, page size and ABI all match.

Start Shizuku and grant this app permission before running. This uses a kernel vulnerability; a miss may reboot the tablet. Root also starts installed Zygisk/Vector modules in the initial late-load, and the explicit module path restarts the Android framework once; this app may close during that restart.

An offline one-button temporary-root, KernelSU late-load and Zygisk/Vector module-stage installer for the exact OnePlus Pad 3 OPD2415_16.0.9.400(EX01) firmware. It runs through Shizuku shell permission, never unlocks the bootloader or wipes data, and root disappears after reboot.
The signer-matched Root My Device KSU Manager is not installed. Install the Manager APK produced with this build; a public Manager APK will not authenticate.
